subject: Cognitia outage: closure packet and RCA confirmation
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@cognitia.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Incident follow-up: March 20 service disruption at Cognitia — request for RCA and timeline

Ben / Monica,

Thanks again for the check-ins yesterday. We had a roughly 45-minute degradation in inference throughput during our evening batch window on 2025-03-20 that caused a backlog of jobs and delayed downstream payroll runs. Our ops team captured a partial timeline but we need the formal RCA and a customer-facing summary to share with our compliance and audit team.

Can you confirm:
- When we can expect a consolidated RCA?
- Any immediate action items we should track internally?
- Whether Redwood will provide evidence logs for our auditors (tokenization logs, timestamps)?

Sana and I will be coordinating the internal compliance review, so please loop her in (cc above). We appreciate the fast response from your team so far.

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Director of Platform Ops
Cognitia

Attachments: customer_event_snapshot.txt (list of affected job ids).

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@cognitia.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident follow-up: March 20 service disruption at Cognitia — request for RCA and timeline

Alex —

Thanks for the note and the snapshot. We're sorry for the disruption and understand the downstream impact. Quick answers up-front:
- We will deliver a customer-ready RCA and timeline by end of day Monday (2025-03-24).
- Immediate mitigations already applied: autoscaler threshold adjustment and KV-cache eviction tuning to avoid tail latency spikes.
- We can provide the requested tokenization/export logs as CSV attachments for your auditors.

I've looped in Hannah (service reliability lead) and Irene (platform engineering) to consolidate the technical timeline and evidence. Monica (CS) will coordinate scheduling for a verification call once the packet is delivered.

Plan: we will circulate the RCA PDF + evidence bundle (redacted where needed) and a short action register with owners and due dates. If that works we'll schedule a 30-minute review for Tue 2025-03-25 (10:00–10:30 PT).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@cognitia.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 Mar 2025 16:30:12 -0700
Subject: Cognitia — customer RCA, timeline and actions (closure packet)

Alex / Sana —

Please find below the customer-facing RCA and the immediate & longer-term actions Redwood will take. Attached: Cognitia_INC-20250320-RCA.pdf (customer summary) and evidence-tokenization-logs.csv (export of relevant tokenization timestamps and request ids). A full technical appendix is in the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqCognitia-RCA-202503.

Executive summary:
- Impact window: 2025-03-20 18:22:10 – 19:07:55 PT (45m 45s).
- Symptoms: elevated tail latency for generation requests, increased queue depth for batch jobs, and downstream delays for scheduled payroll processing.
- User impact: approximately 12% of jobs in the evening batch retried or delayed; no data corruption or unauthorized access detected.

Root cause (short):
A regression in the runtime's KV-cache eviction policy, introduced during a routine kernel optimization deployed on 2025-03-20 17:58 PT, caused cache churn under a specific sequence-length distribution. This churn increased CPU stalls on the inference nodes, which propagated to queue backpressure and ultimately degraded throughput for affected batch jobs.

Detailed timeline (high level):
- 17:58 PT: rollout of runtime kernel optimization to the canary pool (internal).
- 18:10 PT: canary telemetry shows elevated cache evictions under long-sequence requests (automated threshold alerts).
- 18:22 PT: tail-latency spike observed on customer-facing dashboards; Cognitia reported first delayed job.
- 18:27–18:40 PT: internal mitigation attempted (tuned eviction threshold remotely) but did not stabilize for all pools.
- 18:41 PT: rollback of kernel change to previous stable build initiated.
- 18:52 PT: autoscaler engaged and additional capacity brought online.
- 19:07:55 PT: service metrics returned to baseline.

Immediate mitigations applied:
- Rollback of the kernel change (completed 18:41 PT).
- Temporary eviction threshold increase to reduce churn.
- Autoscaler policy widened to provide faster capacity increase for batch windows.

Action register (owner — action — target date):
- hannah_schmitt — run a targeted stress test matrix covering sequence length distributions for Cognitia's workload; deliver results 2025-04-03.
- irene_choi — add per-customer cache-eviction telemetry and alerting; complete 2025-04-07.
- ben_carter / monica_patel — schedule and lead verification call and provide compensation calculation; complete 2025-03-27.
- platform-engineering-team — gate kernel rollouts behind a randomized sequence-length test harness; complete 2025-04-14.

Verification plan:
- Redwood will run a set of controlled replay tests using a redacted subset of Cognitia's workload in our staging environment and share the results within two weeks.
- We will provide tokenization and request-id logs (attached) to support your internal audit.

Compensation note:
- Redwood will calculate prorated service credits for the affected window per our SLA. Monica will circulate the proposed credit calculation separately.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm a time for the 30-minute verification call (we proposed Tue 2025-03-25 10:00–10:30 PT).
2) Let us know if you need redactions or additional evidence for your auditors.
3) We will follow up with the stress-test results and an updated rollout gating policy.

Thanks again for working through this with us — we take this seriously and aim to prevent recurrence.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Cognitia_INC-20250320-RCA.pdf (3 pages), evidence-tokenization-logs.csv (redacted), shared Drive appendix

From: Alex Martinez <alex@cognitia.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: sana@cognitia.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Mar 2025 08:47:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Cognitia — customer RCA, timeline and actions (closure packet)

Ben / team —

Thanks for the thorough packet — that level of detail helps. We can do Tue 2025-03-25 10:00 PT for the verification call. Two quick asks before then:
- Please include a one-page evidence index that maps attached files to auditor-relevant questions (timestamps, request ids, redaction notes).
- We'll need a copy of your SOC 2 attestations or a pointer to where our procurement team can download them for review.

Sana will coordinate the calendar invite. Appreciate the timely follow-through.

Best,
Alex
